The plant has many narrow leaves radiating outward with yellowing/whitish striping on leaves. This bushy, multi-shoot growth habit with numerous tillers sprouting from the base is characteristic of Grassy Shoot disease, which causes abnormal proliferation of thin grass-like shoots.
